slides.headline: Nearly Half of Nonprofits Operate Month to Month
slides.subheadline: What steady giving makes possible for 1.7M organizations

slides.label: Part 1: The Data
slides.headline: Every dollar goes to the mission
slides.accent_label: of nonprofits operate with slim emergency reserves
slides.story: Most nonprofits spend what they receive on the work itself. That commitment is real, and it leaves little room when a grant ends. Steady giving is what carries the work through.

slides.label: Part 2: The Smallest Give the Most
slides.headline: Small organizations run lean by choice
slides.accent_label: of small nonprofits hold less than 3 months of funds
slides.story: Organizations under $500K put nearly every dollar into programs. A donor who stays with them through a funding gap keeps services running for a whole community.

slides.label: Part 3: The Multiplier
slides.headline: Reserves turn stability into growth
slides.accent_label: of reserves lets a nonprofit plan years ahead
slides.story: A nonprofit with six months of reserves can weather funding shifts and commit to long range plans. Reserve support is not charity on top of charity. It is infrastructure.

slides.label: Key Insight
slides.headline: Steady giving is an impact multiplier
slides.accent_label: nonprofits could reach stable footing with steady support
slides.story: Donors who give steadily do more than fund programs. They give organizations the footing to plan, grow, and serve with confidence.

slides.headline: Know the organizations you support
body_lines: Free. Transparent. No rankings, no agenda.
